description: Team of KPI students. We harmonize 25 years of NASA FIRMS active-fire hotspots — MODIS (2000–) and VIIRS (2012–) — into one series on the Suomi NPP VIIRS scale and turn it into a burning calendar for any region on Earth: monthly history, the median of each month, anomalies and CSV/PNG downloads. Ukraine is our detailed example. Live site: https://dorawebstart.github.io/p1t0n/
